content.value_statement: Scholarly search across authors, institutions, and citations can take many manual API steps. This skill provides OpenAlex workflows, helper scripts, and query patterns for fast literature analysis.
actual_capabilities: Search OpenAlex works by topic, title terms, publication year, citation counts, and open access status.
Find works by author or institution using the recommended two-step entity ID pattern.
Retrieve specific works, authors, institutions, and sources by OpenAlex ID, DOI, ORCID, ROR, or ISSN.
Analyze publication trends, topic distributions, citation counts, and open access percentages.
Batch lookup identifiers and paginate large OpenAlex result sets with helper scripts.
Export selected public research metadata to CSV for downstream analysis.
limitations: Requires network access to the public OpenAlex API and depends on its availability and rate limits.
OpenAlex metadata can be incomplete, delayed, or different from publisher records.
The scripts provide query helpers, not a complete review workflow or statistical analysis package.
Large result sets can take time and may need user-defined limits to avoid excessive requests.

use_cases.title: Find Literature Quickly
use_cases.description: Search recent papers by topic, filter by access status, and sort by citation impact.

use_cases.title: Measure Research Output
use_cases.description: Analyze publications, topics, and open access share for an author, lab, or institution.

use_cases.title: Prepare Bibliometric Data
use_cases.description: Collect OpenAlex metadata for papers, journals, citations, and identifiers before deeper analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use OpenAlex to find recent open access papers about climate adaptation. Return titles, years, citation counts, and source names.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an Author
prompt_templates.scenario: Find and summarize one researcher output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find works by Jennifer Doudna with OpenAlex. Summarize publication years, top topics, and the most cited papers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Institutions
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare public research metadata across organizations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare MIT and Stanford publications on quantum computing since 2020. Include volume, top topics, citations, and open access share.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Dataset
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced export for downstream bibliometric analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an OpenAlex workflow to collect up to 10000 synthetic biology works from 2020 to 2024, select core fields, and export CSV.

output_examples.input: Find recent highly cited papers about CRISPR.
output: A ranked list of recent CRISPR papers with titles, years, citation counts, and open access status.
A short note explaining the search filters and sort order used.

output_examples.input: Analyze Stanford University research output from 2020 to 2024.
output: A summary of total works, open access percentage, yearly publication counts, and leading topics.
A concise interpretation of visible trends in the OpenAlex metadata.

output_examples.input: Get metadata for a list of DOIs.
output: A normalized table description covering titles, years, sources, citation counts, DOIs, and access status.
A note about any identifiers that returned no matching OpenAlex record.

best_practices: Provide an email address for the OpenAlex polite pool before running repeated API queries.
Use entity ID lookup before filtering by authors, institutions, sources, topics, or funders.
Limit fields and result counts when exploring a new query to reduce response size and request volume.
anti_patterns: Do not filter by ambiguous author or institution names when an OpenAlex ID is available.
Do not request large pages repeatedly without pagination limits, rate limiting, and clear output fields.
Do not treat OpenAlex citation counts or metadata as final without checking source coverage and update timing.

faq.question: Does this skill need an OpenAlex API key?
faq.answer: No. OpenAlex is open, but adding an email address gives access to the higher rate polite pool.

faq.question: Can it find papers by DOI or ORCID?
faq.answer: Yes. The client supports direct lookups by DOI, ORCID, ROR, ISSN, and OpenAlex identifiers.

faq.question: Can it export results?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples show CSV export for selected public metadata fields after querying or pagination.

faq.question: Can it analyze citation networks?
faq.answer: It can retrieve citation counts and citing works when OpenAlex provides the needed citation endpoint.

faq.question: Is the data always complete?
faq.answer: No. OpenAlex coverage is broad, but records can be incomplete, delayed, or different from publisher metadata.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
